title: Gersen, Peter. "What the US Government Knows About Unidentified Flying Objects." Frontiers of Science. June 30, 1981
doc_notes: This is an archival article by Peter Gersten discussing government knowledge of UFOs and referencing various declassified military and intelligence reports containing encounter data.

encounters.summary: A Cuban pilot reported an encounter between his MIG-21 and a UFO, which was intercepted by USAF Security.
Military personnel reported unconventional aerial objects in the vicinity of nuclear-weapons storage and missile control facilities at multiple Air Force bases.
encounters.location_name: Loring AFB, Wurtsmith AFB, Malstrom AFB, Minot AFB
